title: 第0023章 离宗御剑飞行第0024章 聚宝阁五门中品术法
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
;;
修炼功法是等安顿下来之后的事情。
陆青禾拿出外门手册看了起来，里面讲述了外门弟子的各种规章制度。
外门弟子不仅每月享受宗门的丹药和灵石福利，还可以通过自己的能力获得修炼资源。
正如刚才白羽彤说的，可以加入符阵峰，学习符阵获得灵石。
灵药峰，种植灵药的地方；丹鼎峰，炼制丹药的地方；炼器峰，炼制法器的地方；灵兽峰，圈养灵兽的地方……
当然这些都需要一定的考核，不是想加入就能加入的。
还可以接宗门任务获得丰厚的报酬。
同时每个月都会有内门弟子讲道，讲解各种训练上遇到的问题传授修炼经验。
陆青禾比较感兴趣的是丹鼎峰和灵药峰。
但是也是有条件的，加入丹鼎峰，最低要求就是能够炼制百草丹。
加入灵药峰是能够掌握中级云雨术，无论哪个都不是简单能够达到的。
陆青禾现在是要找一个可以居住的洞府，他拿出令牌。
上面是密密麻麻的点，有亮光的，也有灰暗的。
亮光的是被人占据的洞府，灰暗的是陆青禾可以选择的洞府。
别人选择洞府，是选择灵气比较浓厚的地方，陆青禾完全不一样。
外门的天地灵气比起杂役峰浓厚一倍之上，但是对他五灵根来说完全起不到任何作用。
反而他要寻找一个偏僻没人的地方，毕竟他身上的秘密太多了，一旦别人发现就是天大的灾祸。
很快的陆青禾就在令牌的边缘看到一个洞府的位置，那里周边只有少数的几个亮光。
陆青禾没有停留朝着位置前进。

一路上看到陆青禾杂役服饰，来往的外门弟子都侧目，直到陆青禾发出炼气四层的修为，他们才将目光移开。
陆青禾找了一个偏僻的地方，将代表外门身份的白袍换上，腰间挂上外门弟子的令牌，这才没有受到其他人的关注。
用了半天的时间陆青禾才来到洞府的位置。
和杂役院的院子差不多，洞府都有着禁制，陆青禾将令牌放在上面，禁制发出一道光芒。
洞府和陆青禾的身份令牌绑定，以后只有他可以自由的出入这座洞府。
陆青禾走了进去，洞府不大，和杂役院差不多。
但是又有一些不同，这洞府上布置了一座防御阵法，防止别人强行闯入。
还有聚灵阵法，不断的吸收周围的天地灵气增加洞府的灵气浓度。
陆青禾将洞府清理了一遍，他以后很长时间都要在这里修炼，最少在炼气后期之前都需要呆在这里。
陆青禾拿出完整的【云霁练气诀】开始修炼炼气四层的功法。
但是修炼了小半天，完全没有什么收获，炼气四层的修炼需要的灵气是炼气三层的数倍。
需要的时间同样是数倍，没有灵丹妙药的辅助，陆青禾估计他要炼气四层圆满，可能需要五年的时间都不止。
算了！
陆青禾放弃了常规的训练方式，他一个闪身出现在了黑土空间。
只是眼前的一幕让陆青禾震惊了，原本只有一亩的黑土空间竟然扩大了，扩大了刚好一倍，一亩的黑土灵田现在变成了足足两亩大小。

Practicing the exercises is a matter of waiting for you to settle down.
Lu Qinghe took out the outer sect manual and read it. It described various rules and regulations for outer sect disciples.
Outer disciples not only enjoy the sect’s elixirs and spiritual stone benefits every month, but can also obtain cultivation resources through their own abilities.
As Bai Yutong said just now, you can join the Talisman Formation Peak and learn the Talisman Formation to obtain spiritual stones.
The elixir peak is where elixirs are grown; the Danding Peak is where elixirs are refined; the Weapon Refining Peak is where magic weapons are refined; the Spirit Beast Peak is where spirit beasts are kept in captivity...
Of course, these all require certain assessments, and you can’t just join if you want to.
You can also take on sect missions and get generous rewards.
At the same time, inner disciples will give lectures every month, explaining various problems encountered in training and imparting cultivation experience.
Lu Qinghe is more interested in Danding Peak and Spiritual Medicine Peak.
But there are conditions. To join Danding Peak, the minimum requirement is to be able to refine Baicao Dan.
By joining the Spiritual Medicine Peak, you can master the intermediate cloud and rain technique, which is not something that can be easily achieved.
Lu Qinghe now wanted to find a cave where he could live, so he took out his token.
There are dense dots on it, some are bright and some are dark.
The bright ones are the caves occupied by people, and the dark ones are the caves Lu Qinghe can choose.
When others choose caves, they choose places with stronger spiritual energy. Lu Qinghe is completely different.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the outer sect was more than twice as strong as that of the handyman peak, but it had no effect at all on his five spiritual roots.
Instead, he wants to find a remote place with no one. After all, he has too many secrets, and it will be a huge disaster if others find out.
Soon Lu Qinghe saw the location of a cave on the edge of the token, with only a few bright lights around it.
Lu Qinghe moved towards the location without stopping.
Seeing Lu Qinghe's uniform along the way, the outer disciples who came and went looked sideways. They didn't look away until Lu Qinghe showed the fourth level of Qi Refining.
Lu Qinghe found a remote place, put on the white robe that represented the identity of the outer sect, and hung the token of the outer sect disciple on his waist, so that he did not attract the attention of others.
It took Lu Qinghe half a day to reach the location of the cave.
Similar to the yard of the Servant's Courtyard, the caves have restrictions. Lu Qinghe placed the token on it, and the restrictions emitted a light.
The identity token of the cave and Lu Qinghe are bound, and only he can freely enter and exit the cave in the future.
Lu Qinghe walked in. The cave was not big, almost the same as a courtyard.
But there are some differences. There is a defensive formation on this cave to prevent others from breaking in by force.
There is also a spirit gathering formation that continuously absorbs the surrounding spiritual energy of heaven and earth to increase the concentration of spiritual energy in the cave.
Lu Qinghe cleaned up the cave. He will be practicing here for a long time, at least until the later stage of Qi refining.
Lu Qinghe took out the complete [Yunji Qi Training Technique] and began to practice the fourth level of Qi training.
However, after practicing for a long time, there was no gain at all. The spiritual energy required for the fourth level of Qi Refining is several times that of the third level.
The time required is also several times greater. Without the assistance of a panacea, Lu Qinghe estimates that it may take more than five years for him to perfect the fourth level of Qi refining.
never mind!
Lu Qinghe gave up his regular training methods and appeared in the black earth space.
But the scene in front of him shocked Lu Qinghe. The space that was originally only one acre of black soil actually expanded, almost doubling in size. The one acre of black soil spiritual field now became a full two acres in size.
